correctnessGate.inputConstruction: the three canonical shapes use ex15::kFixtures and ex15::make_fixture directly; only the measurement shape uses the reviewed runner's deterministic generator
correctnessGate.initialOutput: restore each fixture's original deterministic finite C input with a checked host-to-device copy before every stage and attempt; this is required for the nonzero-beta canonical partial fixture and measurement workload
correctnessGate.completion: check every launch and cudaDeviceSynchronize before copying the complete C matrix
correctnessGate.requiredResult: every stage independently passes every edge fixture and the declared workload before any measurement or profiler record is interpreted

method.question: For each adjacent GEMM stage, does matched retained evidence support, reject, or leave unanswered its tile-shape, reuse, resource, occupancy, or traffic hypothesis while the EX15 precision and correctness contract remains fixed?

runner.boundary: compile, link, and static inspection only in three Toolkit Lanes; no execution or Evidence Status

method.completionBoundary: restore initial C, launch one complete GEMM, and check cudaDeviceSynchronize for every attempt

acquisition.invalidBatch: retain the failed batch and restart all ten attempts under a new batch identifier

profiler.availability: retain ncu --version, ncu --list-sections, and ncu --query-metrics from the exact environment
profiler.selection: one minimal queried section or a shorter exact metric list selected after the hypothesis is frozen
profiler.kernelIdentity: retain the actual function-name basis, one unique named stage-kernel filter, launch selection, and mapped template-body instantiation identity
profiler.replay: retain requested and actual replay mode, pass count, save and restore behavior, and perturbation boundary
profiler.custody: hash the primary .ncu-rep, expanded command, query output, stdout, stderr, exit status, observer, and date

permissions.denial: stop, retain the denial, and ask the environment owner for approved access
permissions.prohibited: do not bypass policy with sudo, guess a value, or encode unavailable as zero

interpretation: A correctness pass admits a stage to collection but does not rank it.
A source tile-load or requested-byte estimate is not observed DRAM traffic.
Static shared bytes and source accumulator count are not a complete compiled resource record.
Theoretical or achieved occupancy is a latency-hiding coordinate, not a target to maximize or a speed guarantee.
FP32 device accumulation, double CPU accumulation, FMA contraction, compiler target, and exact compute capability remain explicit coordinates.
A matched profiler report may address the named mechanism but does not prove elapsed-time causality.
L06 and LAB12 remain unpublished; the educational kernel is not a production replacement and this fixture contains no cuBLAS or Tensor Core result.

transformations: This original expected-only plan contains no capture and therefore required no value replacement.

expectedObservations: All four stages should independently pass the exact ex15::kFixtures and ex15::make_fixture inputs, scalars, CPU-reference, and tolerance contract for the three canonical edge fixtures, then pass the declared workload before collection begins.
Every attempt should restore the original C input because beta is nonzero, retain three excluded warm-ups and ten fresh attempts, and check completion without deleting samples.

The K-tile stage should preserve the aligned full-workload requested-byte estimate while reducing source-declared shared storage, increasing barrier count, and changing cooperative-load ownership and issued load groups; only exact compiled resources and hardware limits can answer residency.

The rectangular stage should change directional A/B reuse and increase source-requested bytes per completed output for the declared aligned workload; this estimate is not an observed cache or DRAM value.

The coarsened stage should reduce source-requested A/B values per completed output while increasing source accumulator count; exact compiler output is required before a register or occupancy conclusion.

Exact-GPU version and availability queries, permissions, filtering, replay, report custody, and a complete Environment Manifest should either qualify each profiler record or produce a retained blocker.

Every interpretation should keep source estimates, compiled resources, theoretical occupancy, achieved occupancy, queried traffic, and independent unprofiled elapsed samples in separate evidence columns.
No tile shape should be accepted from memory alone; each remains a workload-, precision-, compiler-, and architecture-bound experimental coordinate.
claimBoundary: This expected-only Q13 fixture contains no recorded environment value, correctness result, profiler report, compiled register count, occupancy, metric name or value, raw sample, timing, traffic, throughput, speedup, bottleneck, winner, cuBLAS comparison, Tensor Core result, or runtime observation. The static runner and fixture create no Runnable Example or Evidence Status.
